conclusion:
8 MLB innings before 2026.
172⅔ this year. An ALCS start next.
intro: Griffin returned from Japan and pitched 172⅔ MLB innings in 2026. Before this year, his entire major-league career added up to eight.
kicker: FOSTER GRIFFIN · A VERY DIFFERENT CHAPTER
methodology: Completed games through October 11, 2026 (MLB official game dates). Annual bars include only MLB regular-season innings, excluding postseason and Japan. Griffin pitched in Japan in 2023–25. The 2026 total covers 31 starts. “An ALCS start next” refers to his announced October 12 Game 1 assignment, not a completed result. Baseball .1/.2 notation is converted to one-third/two-thirds: 518 outs = 172⅔ innings, not 172.2 decimal innings.
Japan interval shading distinguishes no MLB innings from inactivity. No Japan innings are plotted. The chart retains the exact verified annual MLB totals, counting combined-season records once.

presentation.headline: Foster Griffin is scheduled to start tonight for Cleveland.
presentation.subheadline: In his entire Major League career he had pitched just eight innings up until this year. In 2026 he pitched 172⅔.
